already_kept: This page is already kept in Dashboards
bad_action: This button can't be used on this page
bad_title: A title is 1–40 characters on one line
broken_detail: Ask Persona in the chat to update it.
broken_title: This page can't be shown right now
changed: This page just changed, confirm again
delete_confirm: Delete this page now? This can't be undone.
empty_detail: Ask Persona for a page you come back to, like “Make me a page to track my morning runs.”
gone_detail: You can restore it from Dashboards for 30 days.
keep_pin: Keep and pin to the sidebar
kept_limit: You can keep up to 20 pages. Remove one first.
off: Dashboards are off. Turn them on in Settings › Assistant.
offer_expired: Expired: this draft wasn't kept within 7 days.
offer_fallback: Draft dashboard “{title}”: keep it in Dashboards, keep it and pin it to the sidebar, or not now.
offer_withdrawn: Withdrawn: Persona took this draft back.
open_link: This link can only be opened from the chat
pin_limit: You can pin up to 3 pages
redirected: Sent to your main conversation instead
remove_confirm: Remove this page? You can restore it from Dashboards for 30 days.
tap_rate: Too many taps on this page. Try again in a minute.
title_reserved: That's the name of one of the app's own places. Choose another title.
title_taken: Another page already has this title
unavailable: Pages can't be shown right now
version_changed: The dashboard changed. Choose a version again.
version_confirm: Restore the title and content from version {number} and pause updates? Live readings and alert settings are kept.
version_gone: This version is no longer in the history. Choose another version.
